name: titan-email-mcp
description: Community plugin that connects Claude to a Titan Email mailbox (including GoDaddy-hosted Titan) over IMAP/SMTP: list, search, read, draft, reply, send, move, and flag mail.

email.title: Mailbox address
email.description: Your Titan Email address, e.g. you@yourdomain.com

password.title: Mailbox password
password.description: Your Titan Email password, or an app-specific password if your provider offers one. Stored in your system's secure credential store.

provider.title: Mail provider
provider.description: titan if you signed up for Titan Email directly; godaddy if your domain and mailbox were bought through GoDaddy

allow_send.title: Allow sending
allow_send.description: Off by default: Claude can read mail and save drafts but cannot send. Turn on to allow send_email and sending replies.
